analysis.reason: RSI 71.6으로 과매수 구간 진입, 5일 연속 상승으로 단기 과열 우려. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나, 5일 고가 $0.10 돌파 실패. 4배 급증한 거래량은 상승 동력으로 작용하나, 과매수 구간 진입으로 인한 단기 되돌림 가능성 고려하여 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 71.6 enters overbought territory. Five consecutive days of gains raise concerns of short-term overheating. MACD histogram shows improvement, but the price failed to break the 5-day high of $0.10. The 4x surge in volume supports upward momentum, but potential for a short-term pullback due to overbought conditions warrants a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($0.10) vs SMA5/20/50($0.09/$0.09/$0.08): Short-to-mid term trend above, confirming bullish position.
· SMA100/200($0.08/$0.09) relative position: Above mid-to-long term trend, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (16.4%) + Higher position relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.2→71.6) + Overbought entry confirmed + Strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0011→0.0014) + Improvement diagnosed + Trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $0.10) + Bandwidth 24.73% indicating expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.09) + Basis (SMA20, Pivot based).
· Swing resistance ($0.10) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + Previous high breakout unconfirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.90x) + Increased confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + Wait-and-see condition due to short-term overheating.
